messages.author: 6c4d187713e325b8
messages.subject: Non-sensical DIF plotting results
parts:
Hi All!

 I am running DIF using a polytomous GRM and cannot make sense of the plot results. I plotted the item and scale information curves which display nicely. However, they appear incompatible (most likely have been swapped over). As item information curves are additive and sum to the scale information curve, if the items are consistently providing more information at the higher level of the latent trait for one subgroup (in this case group 3) than the other (group 1), then the scale information curve should show this same distinction. However, the scale information curve seems to have swapped the results as the scale information curve shows group 1 has more information at the upper level of the latent trait than group 3. 

I have attached the simple code below and attached the figures for the item and scale information curves.

Regards and thanks in advance,
 Conal Monaghan


# create grouping variable
>polgroup <- as.character(data1$politics3way) 
# run the model
>polModel1 <- multipleGroup(data1[,c(3:8)], model = 1, group = polgroup)
# plot scale information curve
>plot(polModel1, type="info", auto.key=list(space="bottom", columns=2, title="Political Ideology", cex.title=1))
#plot item information curve
>plot(polModel1, type="infotrace", auto.key=list(space="bottom", columns=2, title="Political Ideology", cex.title=1))

Unfortunately, mirt doesn't support the threshold parameterization implicitly. Sometimes you can pass IRTpars=TRUE to coef(), but for the DIF() output this likely isn't possible. You may have to transform the parameters yourself. 

Phil
